neighbours.label: predicts the verb 'play' in audio/video playback contexts: the slot after a music or recording subject ('the song was | played', 'a radio is | playing'), versus the same frames with a non-media subject
fire: The children danced around the room while the music was being played loudly.
We sat in silence as the recording was played for the jury.
Somewhere down the hall a radio is playing an old love song.
As soon as the DVD started playing, the cat jumped onto the couch.
In the study, monkeys heard the melody while it was being played twice a day.
At the ceremony the national anthem was played by a brass band.
On the porch an old cassette was playing his favorite tapes.
Halfway through the concert the orchestra started playing a waltz.
quiet: The children danced around the room while the cake was being sliced carefully.
We sat in silence as the verdict was read to the jury.
Somewhere down the hall a baby is crying for its mother.
As soon as the oven started heating, the cat jumped onto the couch.
In the study, monkeys ate the fruit while it was being weighed twice a day.
At the ceremony the wedding cake was cut by the bride.
On the porch an old dog was chewing his favorite slippers.
Halfway through the dinner the guests started leaving early.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.5 on the verb slot after a song/recording/radio subject; the same frames about food, documents or people below 0.1
notes: Opposite pole suppresses ' play/playing/played', so this pole pushes them. Card: 'while the song was being played', 'recording is playing', 'song started playing', 'DVD player'. Probe: 'anthem started' 0.434, 'song was being played' 0.367, 'record is playing' 0.293, 'will not open in media player' 0.502; but media subjects leak without playback ('record is sitting' 0.293, 'anthem was written' 0.246), so near misses use non-media subjects ('soup was being served' 0.001).
